summary: A school board approves a budget that reverses layoffs by counting on new state money that has not been promised.
realLife: A city school board narrowly passed its chief's budget with an amendment that reversed hundreds of school layoffs, counting on about a hundred fifty million dollars more from the state than the district had projected. The chief warned against it and recalled a past veto that forced layoffs at her own school. A union leader said the state would be pressed. The district said short-term borrowing for payroll was now in doubt; the state's next session was months off.
sources: Chalkbeat Chicago (Chicago, Illinois), 'Seeking to reverse layoffs, Chicago school board approves budget, assuming more state money will come', Jul 31, 2026: https://www.chalkbeat.org/chicago/2026/07/31/seeking-to-reverse-layoffs-chicago-school-board-approves-budget-assuming-more-state-money-will-come/
